title: What If Your Training Tee Could Lift Off Your Skin?
summary: UA Tech Helix, Under Armour's new performance tee built to create space between fabric and skin when the work heats up. At its core is a unique, coil-shaped fiber construction that creates fresh airflow to help eliminate that sticky, sweaty feeling, giving athletes one less distraction and greater freedom to focus on performing at their best.
body_markdown:
### Sweat is part of the work.


As the intensity of a workout builds, so does the moisture. Even a lightweight tee can start to feel heavier and more noticeable against the body.


### But Under Armour believed athletes shouldn’t have to accept that.


This challenge led to UA Tech™ Helix, the brand’s new performance tee built to create space between fabric and skin when the work heats up. At its core is a coil-shaped fiber construction that creates fresh airflow to help eliminate that sticky, sweaty feeling, giving athletes one less distraction and greater freedom to focus on performing at their best.
